items.source: resourceDescription - description of the resource that the bean definition came from
items.translation: resourceDescription - 描述该 Bean 定义来源的资源

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean requested
items.translation: beanName - 请求的 Bean 的名称

items.source: propertyName - the name of the bean property that couldn't be satisfied
items.translation: propertyName - 无法满足的 Bean 属性名称

items.source: ex - the bean creation exception that indicated the unsatisfied dependency
items.translation: ex - 表示未满足依赖的 Bean 创建异常。

items.source: injectionPoint - the injection point (field or method/constructor parameter)
items.translation: injectionPoint - 注入点（字段或方法/构造函数参数）

items.source: Return the injection point (field or method/constructor parameter), if known.
items.translation: 返回注入点（字段或方法/构造函数参数），如果已知的话。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean depends on other beans or simple properties
that were not specified in the bean factory definition, although
dependency checking was enabled.
items.translation: 当 Bean 依赖于未在 Bean 工厂定义中指定的其他 Bean 或简单属性，且启用了依赖检查时抛出异常。
